results.name: battery_self_reported_triggers_record_confirmation
results.description: Elimination-test ruling 2026-08-14 (Waleed): a battery replaced ~2 months ago (fixture: fresh self_reported battery record) should NOT crank slow on a cold morning — the recorded service, if real, would have eliminated the symptom, so the record is in question and the trust gate applies: get_vehicle_health then render_record_confirmation(maintenance_type: battery). Companion to the brake gate case; gives the gate a second crisp flavor for statistical coverage.

turns.user: Car has been slow to crank the last few mornings
turns.text:
Slow cranking usually points to a battery that's struggling to push enough current to turn the engine over — especially on cold mornings when the chemical reactions inside slow down. A few quick things to rule out first:

Is it just a slow turn-over sound, or is it more of a clicking when you hit the key? And has this been the last few mornings specifically, or has it been building for a while?

turns.user: Mostly cold mornings — once it starts, everything runs fine, no warning lights
turns.text:

skipped.name: polite_exit_after_vague_narrowing
skipped.reason: Sprint 2 / Wave 7.x: the polite-exit counter (ai_conversations.diagnostic_turn_count, threshold=6) is incremented in chat.ts inside `if (!skipPersist)`. The harness defaults to debug_skip_persist=true, so the counter never advances and the 6th turn never fires the <polite_exit_required> envelope block. Two unblock paths: (A) decouple the counter from skipPersist (a chat.ts-only change, out of scope for the QA-lead adaptation dispatch), or (B) ship a harness-side seed mutation that sets diagnostic_turn_count=5 before the final turn (also touches convex/). Re-enable once either lands. Intent preserved verbatim — do not delete.
